review_candidates.title: Strategy, Program Quality & Impact Director
review_candidates.description: Mozambique Strategy, Program Quality & Impact Director Organization World Vision Posted 9 Nov 2026 Closing date 20 Nov 2026 With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith. Come join our 33,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories! Here’s Where You Come In As Strategy, Program Quality & Impact Director , you will provide strategic and technical leadership to a multidisciplinary team of technical and sector specialists, including the Design, Monitoring and Evaluation (DME) team. You will ensure high-quality technical guidance, effective application of approved project models and approaches, and compliance with organisational standards and best practices to strengthen programme quality and maximise sustainable impact for children, families and communities. You will design and institutionalise a comprehensive Strategy Performance Monitoring Framework covering Ministry Impact, Ministry Funding, Operational Excellence, and People, Learning & Growth. You will monitor and report performance against agreed targets, provide regular updates to leadership and stakeholders, lead the annual Strategy Review with SMT and SST, and oversee the implementation of at least one strategic initiative assigned by your supervisor. Key Performance Area Integrated Programme Framework (IPF) Implementation, Monitoring and Learning Programme Framework Implementation You will lead staff orientation and capacity building on IPF and Most Simplified Solution (MSS) requirements, integrate Sponsorship Minimum Programme Requirements (MVPs), guarantees and Future Ready Sponsorship (FRS) into implementation, and ensure that ADP plans are evidence-based and contextually relevant. Monitoring and Performance Measurement You will lead project and programme monitoring and performance measurement, including the annual impact measurement process across 22 APs. You will strengthen data collection, analysis, quality assurance and use, standardise monitoring tools and practices, and ensure findings inform programme adaptation and improvement. Learning, Documentation and Reporting You will ensure timely submission of high-quality quarterly reports, strengthen evidence-based learning, documentation and knowledge management, and promote the use of evidence to improve programme quality, impact and innovation. Knowledge Management, Learning, Research and External Engagement You will lead the development and implementation of a Knowledge Management and Learning (KML) framework that promotes continuous learning, innovation and evidence-based decision-making. You will oversee research, evaluations, learning reviews and case studies; ensure programme impact is measured and communicated; strengthen knowledge-sharing and communities of practice; and share evidence and best practices with partners, donors, government stakeholders and the wider World Vision Partnership to support influence, visibility and resource mobilisation. Leadership, Line Management and Coordination with Sectors You will provide overall leadership and management of the SPQI function, ensuring effective planning, prioritisation, resource allocation and delivery of objectives. You will foster collaboration and accountability across technical, programme, operations, grants and support teams; coordinate cross-sector planning and implementation; support technical teams in delivering quality programmes; and facilitate regular reviews to address challenges and monitor progress. You will also strengthen coordination between the National Office, Area Programmes, Regional Office and Global Centre. Organisational Culture, Staff Supervision and Staff Development You will provide strategic direction and oversight to the PQI/DME teams, building a collaborative, accountable and high-performing culture. You will lead staff capacity development on programme quality, DMEAL and good development practices; promote continuous learning and professional development; and ensure technical staff provide appropriate guidance and support across operational areas. You will also develop individual development plans, coach and mentor direct reports, and lead talent management and succession planning to strengthen staff capabilities and organisational continuity. Requirements Include Minimum of 10 years in managerial and leadership positions, demonstrating increasing levels of responsibility. Advanced/graduate degree with an additional post-graduate in a relevant field, potentially including public health, development, M&E, statistics, or a related discipline. Demonstrated expertise in development of user-friendly tools and resources for MEAL and utilization of learning platforms for helping others learn. Qualitative and/or quantitative research and evaluation skills, including but not limited to study design, survey instrument design and use, establishing and measuring outcome and process indicators, sampling, data analysis plans, data cleaning, and statistical analysis. Demonstrated experience in business strategy development, monitoring and reporting. Experience and competencies data analysis using appropriate software tools (e.g. SPSS, SAS, ABTAB). Experience in synthesizing new learnings and developing approaches for change within the organization. Strong experience in developing capacity building materials and rolling out new approaches across the organization. Knowledge of the monitoring and evaluation requirements of key institutional donors (UN Donors, EU, USAID, etc.). Consistently demonstrates high-level influence and strategic engagement skills and tactical savvy in delivery of technical assistance. Comfort and confidence working in a diverse and inclusive team environment. Ability to think broadly and look at the macro, strategic issues to inform strategy choices and management process Portuguese is not mandatory, but it will be an added advantage. Fluency in both spoken and written English is essential. Applicant Types Accepted: Local and International Applicants (IA's) Accepted How to apply Is this the job for you? Find the full responsibilities and requirements for this position and apply online by the closing date November 20, 2026. World Vision is dedicated to our team members’ development and their success. We aspire for all employees to be fulfilled through their work and their contributions to an organisation working to provide long-term sustainable solutions to the world’s most vulnerable people. For more information on World Vision International, please visit our website: www.wvi.org. Our vision for every child, life in all its fullness. Our prayer for every heart, the will to make it so. review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Microbial Resistance Surveillance Specialist Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home Level: Senior About the Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Microbial Resistance Surveillance Specialist to oversee remote antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance analysis, microbiological data quality review, trend monitoring, and technical reporting. The role focuses on analyzing antimicrobial susceptibility data, identifying emerging resistance patterns, evaluating surveillance indicators, and supporting evidence-based infection prevention and antimicrobial stewardship initiatives. This is a fully remote analytical and technical oversight position. Physical specimen collection, laboratory processing, microbial culture, susceptibility testing, and instrument operation must be performed by qualified local laboratory personnel. Key Responsibilities Analyze antimicrobial resistance surveillance datasets from clinical laboratories, healthcare facilities, and approved reporting systems. Monitor trends in antimicrobial susceptibility and resistance among clinically significant bacterial and fungal organisms. Review microbiology data for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and reporting quality. Evaluate resistance patterns across organisms, antimicrobial agents, healthcare settings, and reporting periods. Identify unusual resistance trends, emerging resistance phenotypes, and potential clusters requiring further investigation. Review antimicrobial susceptibility testing records and laboratory data summaries for consistency with applicable testing standards. Analyze resistance indicators, including multidrug-resistant organism trends and other relevant surveillance measures. Support the development of dashboards, statistical summaries, and periodic antimicrobial resistance reports. Review data submissions and identify inconsistencies in organism identification, susceptibility results, and reporting classifications. Coordinate with microbiologists, infection prevention teams, epidemiologists, and antimicrobial stewardship professionals. Support surveillance methodology development, data definitions, reporting criteria, and quality assurance procedures. Conduct retrospective trend analysis and assess changes in resistance patterns over time. Review relevant scientific literature and public health guidance concerning antimicrobial resistance. Contribute to technical assessments of surveillance coverage, data limitations, and reporting reliability. Support investigations into potential resistance clusters through remote analysis of available epidemiological and laboratory data. Maintain controlled documentation, analytical records, data dictionaries, and surveillance methodology references. Recommend improvements to data quality, reporting consistency, and surveillance workflows. Prepare technical presentations and evidence-based reports for authorized healthcare and public health stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Medical Laboratory Science, Biomedical Science, Epidemiology, Public Health, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in Microbiology, Infectious Disease Epidemiology, Public Health, or a relevant field is an advantage. Typically 5–8 years of experience in microbiology, antimicrobial resistance surveillance, laboratory data analysis, or infectious disease monitoring. Strong understanding of antimicrobial resistance mechanisms, bacterial pathogens, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing principles. Familiarity with multidrug-resistant organisms and clinically significant resistance patterns. Experience interpreting antimicrobial susceptibility datasets and microbiology laboratory reports. Knowledge of relevant susceptibility testing and interpretive standards, such as CLSI or EUCAST. Understanding of epidemiological surveillance methods, resistance indicators, and data quality assurance. Experience using statistical tools, spreadsheets, databases, or analytical software for surveillance reporting. Familiarity with laboratory information management systems and electronic health or public health reporting platforms. Ability to interpret scientific literature and translate technical findings into clear surveillance recommendations. Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent technical writing, presentation, and stakeholder communication abilities. High standards of data confidentiality, scientific integrity, and documentation control. Ability to work independently and coordinate multidisciplinary activities in a fully remote environment. What We Offer A fully remote, work-from-home position based in the UAE. Competitive compensation aligned with qualifications and professional experience. Opportunities to contribute to antimicrobial resistance monitoring and public health surveillance. Collaboration with microbiology, epidemiology, infection prevention, and antimicrobial stewardship professionals. Professional development in infectious disease surveillance, microbiological data analysis, and public health reporting. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting their experience in microbiology, antimicrobial resistance surveillance, susceptibility data analysis, and epidemiological reporting. Application Subject: Application – Senior Microbial Resistance Surveillance Specialist (UAE Remote) Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. Role Scope: This position is fully remote and focuses on surveillance analytics, digital laboratory data review, technical reporting, and coordination. Physical specimen collection, handling, culture, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, molecular testing, and laboratory instrument operation must be performed by qualified local laboratory personnel. Clinical diagnosis, patient treatment decisions, infection control directives, public health notifications, and formal regulatory or statutory reporting must be handled or approved by appropriately authorized healthcare and public health professionals.

review_candidates.title: Senior Counsel
review_candidates.description: About Us At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked. We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavor Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better. About the Role We're hiring our first Senior Counsel: the General Counsel's first hire and the second lawyer at the company. Because Félix is a regulated fintech, Legal is part of every major decision! You'll be brought in early and work with our VPs and C-suite on the company's most important commercial deals, from structuring and negotiation strategy through signing, so your advice will directly shape how we build and grow. As we expand from remittances into credit, yield, and wallet products, you'll own our commercial contracting and lead on Latin American legal matters. It's a senior, independent role, and the impact goes beyond the deals themselves: you'll use top-tier legal skills to serve the Latino community, helping build financial products for people the traditional system has overlooked. Responsibilities Lead negotiation and drafting of commercial agreements across our fintech stack. That includes payout partners across Latin America, liquidity providers, payment and card networks, stablecoin issuers and crypto infrastructure providers, yield providers, and banking-as-a-service platforms. Negotiate technology agreements: master services agreements, API and platform integrations, and data-sharing arrangements. You'll turn what business needs from a partner into enforceable contract terms, including consumer data protection. Bring commercial contract review in-house. You'll review complex agreements independently and reduce our reliance on outside counsel. Own Latin American legal matters: employment and contractor arrangements for our teams across the region, FX and marketing rules, and the regulations that govern how we operate in each market. Build our contract review playbooks and run them on AI-powered legal tech, so Legal can scale efficiently. Handle the range of legal questions that come up in a fast-moving business. This is a generalist role in a legal function that is still being built, and the work won't stay inside the commercial lane. Help build the processes and templates a growing legal department runs on. Areas of law you'll encounter The commercial work sits at the intersection of several regulated areas. You will not be the subject-matter expert in all of them, but you should be able to spot the issues, engage credibly with specialists, and know when a deal point carries regulatory consequences: Financial services and technology commercial contracting Data privacy Money transmission Securities Intellectual property Consumer lending Latin American law - employment, regulatory, commercial Requirements US-qualified attorney, admitted and in good standing, and allowed to practice in the state where you live. Strong academic credentials. A JD or LLM from a leading US law school is preferred. Qualified to practice in at least one Latin American country, with experience coordinating legal work across several countries in the region. 7+ years of legal experience. Ideally, that's several years at a top-tier international law firm (US or Latin American office) followed by at least two years in-house doing commercial work at a fintech, bank, or financial services company. Hands-on experience with technology deals: MSAs, API integrations, data privacy, and the contracting involved in launching a new technology partner. Comfort with the financial side: you understand FX rates, liquidity providers, credit, and yield products, payment rails, and how a deal term affects pricing and the customer experience. Proven ability to run complex commercial negotiations independently and reach commercially sound outcomes. Experience building contract review playbooks and using AI or legal tech to automate or speed up review. Real curiosity about the business. You can explain what makes a product work and why it wins, not just what its contracts say. Spanish fluency, both conversational and legal. You can review Spanish-language agreements and read Spanish-language statutes and regulations without translation. These are the applicable requirements, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. What We Offer Competitive salary Initial stock options grant Annual performance bonus Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave Hybrid work setup Health, dental, and vision plans 401(k) with employer matching, for US-based employees Continuous learning opportunities Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $200,000 and $225,000 USD, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. review_candidates.title: Senior Analyst, Finance Systems
review_candidates.description: About Vantage Group Vantage Group is a global leader in airport and transportation investment, development, management, and advisor services. Since 1994, Vantage's corporate and network-wide team has managed an award-winning portfolio, building strong partnerships that integrate global expertise and local know-how to solve complex transportation challenges at every network location. Over three decades, Vantage has built a track record of creating customized solutions to transform airports and transportation centers that benefit the passengers, stakeholders, and communities they serve. Vantage is a wholly owned strategic platform of Investcorp Corsair Infrastructure Partners for capital deployment in the airport and transportation sectors. Visit vantagegroup.com to learn more. Position Summary This role is the hands-on finance execution arm of Finance Systems. The Senior Analyst works inside an active transformation program spanning ERP upgrades and implementation, a data warehouse buildout, a reporting platform migration, and a pipeline of net-new finance systems including financial close management and treasury management. The work spans configuration, testing, reconciliation, and user enablement across each of these initiatives, from requirements through go-live and into steady-state support. Under the direction of the Senior Manager, this role operates within established governance frameworks: executing implementation tasks across the full project portfolio, validating controls, flagging issues, and escalating decisions that exceed analyst-level authority. The right person has completed at least one full implementation start to finish and can independently identify and act on what needs to happen at every stage. ­ Key Responsibilities 1. Finance Systems Implementation Execution (Primary Focus) Execute configuration, testing, and go-live tasks for ERP enhancements, workflow automations, and reporting integrations across finance and capital asset modules. Support net-new system implementations (financial close management, treasury management, future finance platforms) by owning requirements validation, configuration testing, UAT execution, and hyper-care support. Build and run detailed UAT scripts and regression test suites from scratch across ERP, financial close, treasury, data warehouse, and reporting platforms. This includes designing test scenarios, not only participating in end-user testing. Support data warehouse implementation tasks including data migration validation, schema testing, transformation logic verification, and source-to-report lineage checks. Support reporting platform migration by validating dimension-to-report mappings, reconciliation workbooks, and multi-entity actuals/budget/prior-year comparatives. Perform pre- and post-implementation accounting reconciliations: verify transaction flows, journal entries, depreciation schedules, and sub-ledger-to-GL balancing across entities. Execute dimension structure migrations, configuration releases, and master data changes under established change-management protocols. Triage and resolve system and posting discrepancies with technical teams, verifying accounting integrity before business sign-off. Drive open items to completion with documentation, user enablement, and a clean audit trail. When dependencies stall, advance what can be done independently, document gaps with owners and timelines, and escalate blockers with a recommended path forward. 2.Controls Compliance & Data Integrity Validate financial application controls (manual and automated) during and after implementations, aligned to the Finance Systems Governance Framework. Perform scheduled data integrity checks across ERP, data warehouse, and reporting layers, identifying and escalating discrepancies before they reach financial reporting. Maintain the finance systems change log covering configuration changes, dimension updates, master data modifications, and access changes, keeping the environment audit-ready. Support periodic access reviews and SoD assessments under the Senior Manager’s direction, flagging conflicts and recommending remediation. Support Silver and Gold-layer schema validation in the data warehouse, verifying transformation logic and source-to-report data lineage. 3.Documentation, Enablement & Stakeholder Engagement Package every completed implementation into a complete handover including SOPs, process swim lanes, audit-ready test evidence, and release notes. Deliver targeted training walk-throughs and job aids to finance end-users; provide hands-on hyper-care support immediately after deployments. Build credibility with business stakeholders by communicating system changes clearly, listening to end-user concerns, and translating technical outcomes into language finance teams trust. Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Operations, IT, and HR to gather requirements, align on testing timelines, and support change adoption across departments. Maintain GL account change-control logs and mapping request documentation via established governance mechanisms. Identify automation and process-improvement opportunities within routine finance workflows and bring recommendations to the Senior Manager. 4.Other Duties Perform day-to-day administrative tasks across the finance systems ecosystem including ERP, data warehouse, reporting, financial close, treasury, and future platforms. This includes maintaining configuration settings, and system health under the Senior Manager's direction. Support ongoing ERP maintenance, patch testing, and minor enhancement requests outside of major implementation cycles. Assist with data warehouse operational tasks including monitoring data loads, investigating failed pipelines, and validating refresh cycles. Support reporting platform administration including report maintenance, dimension hierarchy updates, and assist user access provisioning with Vantage IT. Perform other duties as assigned in support of the finance systems function and broader Finance team objectives. ­ About You Qualifications & Experience You hold a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, MIS or other related discipline. 5-8 years of hands-on experience in finance systems implementation, ERP business analysis, financial QA/testing, or accounting advisory/systems consulting. At least one end-to-end finance systems implementation from requirements through go-live and hyper-care, with active involvement in configuration, UAT design, reconciliation, and cutover, not solely end-user participation. Multi-entity or multi-subsidiary environment experience, including validating accounting integrity across legal entities. Exposure to adjacent finance technology projects (data warehouse builds, reporting platform migrations, financial close tools, treasury systems) beyond core ERP work. CPA or equivalent designation is considered an asset. Skills & Capabilities Hands-on experience with a mid-market or enterprise ERP platform (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, SAP, NetSuite, or comparable). Familiarity with financial close management platforms and treasury management systems is an asset. Exposure to reporting/consolidation platforms and data platform concepts (medallion architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, data lineage) is a plus. Advanced Excel (Power Query, pivot analysis, nested lookups); working familiarity with SQL. Structured documentation skills: SOPs, swim lanes, and audit-ready test evidence. Strong bias for execution. Delivers complete, reviewed work without requiring follow-up. Gets into the detail and stays there until the issue is fully resolved. Builds trust with stakeholders through preparation, follow-through, and clear communication. Comfortable in a fast-moving transformation environment with concurrent workstreams and hard deadlines. Sounds professional judgement and the ability to make decisions independently and, when needed, to escalate to the Senior Manager. What we offer In addition to competitive compensation, career progression, and access to a global team of talented professionals, we are growing and offer boundless opportunities to make your mark within our organization. If you share our sense of adventure, come, and join us for the journey. Compensation: The expected annual compensation for this position includes a base salary plus eligibility for an annual incentive. The expected annual compensation for this position includes a base salary of CAD $100,000 to $115,000 plus eligibility to participate in the Company's annual incentive program. Beyond competitive compensation, we offer career progression opportunities, access to a global team of talented professionals, and boundless opportunities to make your mark within our organization. If you share our sense of adventure, we invite you to join us on the journey. Primary Work Location: This is a remote position with a strong preference for candidates located in the Greater Toronto Area. Travel may be required to corporate offices and current network assets locations as needed for this role. Work Authorization : Only qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in Canada will be considered. AI Disclosure: We may use artificial intelligence-powered tools to support candidate sourcing. All applications are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition and Hiring teams, and all selection and hiring decisions are made by human decision-makers. Vacancy Disclosure : This posting is for an existing vacancy. To Apply Please visit our Careers page at https://www.vantagegroup.com/careers/ and follow prompts to apply with your cover letter and résumé. At Vantage Group, we seek and welcome unique backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and skills. As a global organization, we believe that a diverse, inclusive, and empowered workforce strengthens our ability to innovate and succeed. We are committed to fostering an environment where everyone can contribute, grow, and thrive. Accommodation for Applicants We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us at careers@vantagegroup.com. We will work with you to provide appropriate support, and requesting an accommodation will not affect your consideration for employment. Apply for this job online
